text:
Yes, operating profit is turning into cash. The headline PAT overstates what converts.

CFO/PAT was 1.08x over the last 3 years on reported PAT. [Numbers]
On FY26 adjusted PAT of Rs845cr, CFO of Rs1,782cr is about 2.1x. [Numbers][Q4 FY26 call]
The cash conversion cycle was -7 days in FY26, so supplier credit funds working capital. [Numbers]

The weak spot is free cash flow.
FCF across FY23-26 was Rs276cr, Rs16cr, Rs254cr and Rs724cr, lumpy because of heavy capex (Rs1,058cr in FY26). [Numbers][Q4 FY26 call]
The cumulative Rs1,270cr is about 36% of reported PAT of Rs3,507cr. [Numbers]

Fair-value gains inflate reported profit but produce no cash.
About 70% of Q1 FY27 PAT was non-operating. [Q1FY27 call]
So judge earnings on CFO and adjusted PAT.
